Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Below is a concise recap and the set of agreed next steps so we have shared clarity:

High-level needs you described
- Hard data residency for EU-only processing and storage (no cross-border replicas).
- Strong regulatory driver for an air-gapped / isolated option for PII/PHI workflows (certification & auditability are mandatory).
- Minimal inbound connectivity from your environment, with most management via a controlled ops channel (you called this "pull-only updates").

Primary goals
1) Get a short pilot running in your staging environment (EU region) with a controlled dataset to validate throughput and latencies.
2) Agree on security controls (network boundaries, KMS integration, audit log export cadence).
3) Identify procurement and timeline constraints for an on-prem or VPC-hosted offering and flag any blockers for a compliance review.

Open constraints we captured
- Network: egress-only requirement for the deployment node, strict firewall rules (no outbound internet except updates through a bastion), and static allowlist for support/debug sessions.
- Data flow: no long-term backups outside EU; short-lived KV cache permitted in-region only.
- Auth & keys: customer-managed KMS required; support for HSM-backed keys preferred.

Immediate next steps (owners & ETA)
- Redwood: share a trimmed VPC/air-gap checklist and an initial SOW template for an isolated pilot — attached (Irene) — ETA: EOD Wednesday (2027-06-02).
- Medicore: confirm the procurement contact and whether you have a standard NDA or SOW terms we should review (Elena) — ETA: reply to this thread.
- Redwood infra: schedule a 60m technical deep-dive to validate ports, routing, and update cadence (Ben) — propose slots in this thread.

Attachments referenced
- redwood-vpc-checklist.pdf (application/pdf) — checklist mapping network & residency controls we discussed
- sow-template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document) — baseline SOW for an isolated pilot

If that matches your notes, please reply with any clarifications and confirm the procurement email to loop in contracting.

Best,

Elena — quick technical responses to your two asks:

1) Lead time:
- VPC isolated cluster (Redwood-managed within your EU cloud tenancy): typically 3-4 weeks to provision and harden, assuming no additional networking approvals.
- On-prem / air-gapped appliance: 6-10 weeks depending on shipping, on-site validation, and your approval cycle for binaries.

2) Offline upgrades:
- Yes, we support controlled offline upgrade flows. We can provide signed artifacts (SHA256-signed) for your internal validation and guidance for applying updates via an ops bastion. Our recommended pattern for air-gapped installs is: staging validation -> signed artifact delivery -> customer-driven install window.

Networking specifics (high-level, to accelerate the deep-dive):
- Management plane: pull-based updates via a customer-controlled bastion; support for allowlisted IPs and pre-approved certificate pins.
- Metrics & logs: push to your in-region logging endpoint (we can ship compressed, encrypted bundles on a schedule you define).
- Ports: primarily outbound TLS (443) for update artifact retrieval; support for explicit proxy/NAT traversal.

I'll propose 3 slots for the infra deep-dive tomorrow on calendar. Monica — can you add a short runbook artifact (2 pages) outlining the port matrix and recommended firewall rules we should bring to the call?

Thanks,
